summary: KB Financial Group reported a board resolution to pay a quarterly cash dividend of KRW 1,155 per common share, totaling approximately KRW 405.5 billion based on ~351 million outstanding shares. The record date is August 7, 2026, with payment expected within one month under Korean law. The total may adjust for treasury share acquisitions. The filing, a Form 6-K (equivalent to a U.S. dividend announcement), confirms a return of capital to shareholders. Watch for any changes in share count or future dividend policy adjustments.
